_doc: How summarize.jq (and the inlined copy in cloudshell-oneshot.sh) classifies aws-nuke listing-failed (lister) errors.
One lister error = {resource_type, error}. First match wins, in this order:
expected   regex on the raw error -> the API does not exist / is not offered for this account in this region: nothing can hide there
maybe_scp  regex -> access denied WITHOUT a reason: an SCP of the reseller Organization OR regional gating. Shown on one quiet line
transient  regex -> 5xx / throttling: a real failure (counted in LIST-ERR) but listed on one line - re-run to confirm
anything else -> unexpected: one LISTING FAILED line per type, counted in LIST-ERR (resources of that type were NOT scanned)
Regexes are jq/Oniguruma (case-sensitive unless (?i:...)); $ = end of string, so use (?:\n|$) for end of line.
Samples: real CloudShell dry-run, aws-nuke v3.68.3, 17 regions, 2026-10-15 (tests/fixtures/real-cloudshell-v3.68.3-listing-failed.jsonl).
cloudshell-oneshot.sh embeds this file verbatim in a quoted heredoc - keep the copies identical (a test compares them).

expected.why: the service has no endpoint in this region
API not offered in this region (Bedrock custom models / model customization: 404 UnknownOperationException or ValidationException Unknown operation)

expected.re: InvalidAction: The action \w+ is not valid for this web service
expected.why: EC2 API not offered in this region (Verified Access in ap-northeast-3, eu-west-3)
DocumentDB is not offered in this region (us-west-1: DescribeDBClusters -> Unrecognized engine name: docdb)
account not onboarded for the service in this region (Cloud Directory: Account N is not authorized for region R)

expected.re: (?i:account is(?:n.t| not) authorized to (?:call this operation|make this call|invoke this API operation))
expected.why: service-side regional/feature gating, not IAM and not an SCP (those say is not authorized to perform ...): Comprehend NotAuthorizedException, Transcribe language models, Bedrock evaluation jobs
API switched off by AWS (Glue GetDevEndpoints)

maybe_scp.why: explicit deny by an SCP of the Organization the account belongs to - we cannot list, students usually cannot create either
AccessDenied with an EMPTY message (Rekognition, Textract, Timestream for InfluxDB): an SCP deny or a region where the account is not enabled - cannot tell which

maybe_scp.re: Unable to determine service/operation name to be authorized
maybe_scp.why: 403 from the authorization layer (SSM Quick Setup in ap-northeast-3): usually a region without the service, possibly an SCP

transient.why: HTTP 5xx from the service (Bedrock prompts/flow aliases in us-west-1 returned 500)
